data.description: The Shoulder Twirl is a single shoulder wheel on a post, finished in Ocean Grey. The user stands facing the wheel, takes the handle and turns it in slow, wide circles, first one way and then the other. It moves the shoulder through its full range, which helps people with stiff shoulders and office workers who sit for long hours. The single version suits a small open gym or a spot beside a walking path where only one machine will fit. It belongs to our Fun Fitness range, and its twin-wheel version is the Shoulder Twirl Double. Sales can share the exact size and warranty cover on request. The Shoulder Twirl warranty will be confirmed in your quote; standard terms give 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings.

items.pText: The Shoulder Twirl is a single shoulder wheel on a post, finished in Ocean Grey. The user stands facing the wheel, takes the handle and turns it in slow, wide circles, first one way and then the other. It moves the shoulder through its full range, which helps people with stiff shoulders and office workers who sit for long hours. The single version suits a small open gym or a spot beside a walking path where only one machine will fit. It belongs to our Fun Fitness range, and its twin-wheel version is the Shoulder Twirl Double. Sales can share the exact size and warranty cover on request. The Shoulder Twirl warranty will be confirmed in your quote; standard terms give 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings.

The wheel turns on a bearing at its hub, which should run smoothly and quietly; grease it when it starts to drag. A single-post machine like this is often fixed self-standing on a firm slab. Leave standing room in front of the wheel and keep the path behind the user clear.
